qualification: Reported ages reconstruct the retention recurrence using true rounded root counts decoded from immutable log1p summaries. The neural forward uses float32 expm1 approximations to those counts, so reported ages are descriptive reconstructed values, not byte-exact saved age tensors. More importantly, soft expected age is not a hard memory cutoff or ground-truth Fish objective lifetime; small long-history contributions may remain. No long-lived strategic objective behavior has been demonstrated.
